current_evidence: Harrow's 'Apply for planning permission' page (harrow.gov.uk/planning-developments/apply-planning-permission/2) links this same file ID (23287) as 'Local Planning Validation Requirements'. The page mentions no newer or draft list, and searches found nothing more recent.

issues.detail: The List date of 2024-01-01 comes from the PDF CreationDate metadata. The date printed on the document's cover is 1 February 2024.
The 'Planning page' in the reference row is just the council homepage (https://www.harrow.gov.uk), not the page that publishes the validation list.
issues.evidence: The list is linked from https://www.harrow.gov.uk/planning-developments/apply-planning-permission/2 as 'Local Planning Validation Requirements'

issues.detail: Grokbot shows Householder as '(none)', but the document has a Householder application section and several local items that cover householder work. Site-specific Flood Risk Assessment: extensions, outbuildings and hard surfacing in mapped flood zones or surface-water flood areas. Preliminary protected species survey: roof or loft alterations. Material details: 'All major, minor and householder' applications with visible new development. CIL PAAIR form. DAS: 100 sqm or more in a conservation area. Heritage statement: applications affecting heritage assets. Tree survey: trees on or adjacent to the site. GLA Planning Data Standard: all applications.
issues.evidence: Material details: 'All major, minor and householder planning applications involving new development visible'; Biodiversity: 'If there are to be alterations to a roof or loft space'

issues.detail: Many local requirements were not captured under any application type. Affordable Housing Statement: 10 or more dwellings. Accommodation Management Plan: specialist housing such as care homes, nursing homes, supported and student housing. Airport safeguarding details: sites near RAF Northolt. GLA Planning Data Standard: all applications in the GLA area. Noise Impact Assessment: development that would generate noise disturbance. Open Space Assessment: development on designated open space that results in a net loss. Photographs/photomontages: demolition, or development affecting a conservation area or listed building. Protected View Assessment: development affecting a named protected view. Statement of Community Involvement. Statement of Need: D1/D2 community facilities. Sustainability statement: major and minor schemes. SuDS strategy: all major and minor development and anything in a Critical Drainage Area. Transport Statement/Assessment: development with car parking or traffic implications. Travel Plan: significant transport implications. Tree survey/arboricultural assessment: trees on site, on the street or on adjoining land. Biodiversity Net Gain assessment: mandatory under Schedule 7A. Roof plans: where a roof is created or altered. Reasonable exception statement, a fire-safety item.
issues.evidence: Affordable Housing: 'This is required for proposals of 10 or more dwellings.'; Protected View: 'required for all new development that affects a protected view'; Statement of Need: 'applications for community facilities (D1 and D2)'
issues.grok_comment: Most of the listed items (affordable housing, noise, transport, travel plan, tree survey, protected views and others) are missing. But the workbook does have a "Drainage Strategy / SuDS" row ("Surface water drainage strategy must be set out within the FRA...") and an "Energy / Sustainability Statement" row, so SuDS and sustainability are captured, though poorly.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. SuDS and sustainability have (poor) rows. The other missing items stand.

issues.detail: Many Full planning triggers are sentence fragments with no actual trigger. Air Quality ('provide an air quality assessment.') should say major applications only, for schemes that may affect air quality or are in or near an AQMA. CIL ('in determining CIL liability.') should say new buildings or extensions of 100 sqm or more, or any new dwelling. Energy ('a detailed energy assessment.') should say major development. Flood Risk Assessment ('a SiteSpecific Flood Risk Assessment...') omits Flood Zones 2 and 3, surface-water areas, sites of 1 ha or more, Critical Drainage Areas and minor development. Planning Statement, Highways, Archaeology and EIA have similarly truncated excerpts.
issues.evidence: Air Quality: 'This is for Major Planning Applications only.'; CIL: 'Applications for new buildings or extensions which involve the creation of 100 square metres or more'; Energy: 'each major development proposal to submit a detailed energy assessment'

issues.detail: The Design and Access Statement trigger is actually text from the heritage statement item ('incorporated within a Design and Access statement ... heading Heritage Statement'). The source's DAS trigger is major development, or development in a designated area of one or more dwellings or 100 sqm or more of floorspace.
issues.evidence: Excerpt: 'incorporated within a Design and Access statement, however, they will need to include the heading Heritage Statement'

issues.detail: The trigger for Planning Obligations / S106 draft Heads of Terms is a viability sentence ('scale of planning obligations and other costs, a viability assessment is necessary'), not the heads-of-terms requirement.
issues.evidence: Excerpt: 'scale of planning obligations and other costs, a viability assessment is necessary.'

issues.detail: The Lighting Assessment trigger is the biodiversity sentence about submitting a plan for external lighting or landscaping changes. The source's lighting assessment applies to publicly accessible developments near residential property, a listed building, a conservation area or open countryside where external lighting is provided.
issues.evidence: 'Proposals involving the provision of publicly accessible developments in the vicinity of residential property'

issues.detail: 'Landscaping scheme / Landscape plan' is placed under Listed building consent. Its excerpt actually contains the lighting assessment trigger, which mentions 'a listed building'. The source's landscaping details are a general planning requirement, not an LBC item.
issues.evidence: Excerpt: '...Proposals involving the provision of publicly accessible developments in the vicinity of residential property, a listed building or conservation area...'

issues.detail: Heritage Statement appears only under Listed building consent and Advertisement consent. The source says it is needed for 'listed building consent, planning permission or advertisement consent' affecting heritage assets, so it is missing from Full planning and Householder.
issues.evidence: 'A heritage statement is needed for any application for listed building consent, planning permission or advertisement consent that affects...'

issues.detail: Rows are routinely marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' even where the source gives a wider scope. Drainage strategy covers 'all new development applications including a single dwelling', which includes householder and minor work. The ecological row's loft/roof protected species survey is mainly a householder trigger.
issues.evidence: 'Surface water drainage strategy must be set out within the FRA for all new development applications including a single dwelling.'

issues.detail: The Daylight/Sunlight trigger is cut off. It keeps only the overshadowing and shading clauses and loses the main trigger, buildings over four storeys adjoining developed land or public open space. The site levels/sections trigger is mixed with vehicular access text.
issues.evidence: 'buildings exceeding four storeys in height where adjoining other developed land'

issues.detail: The trigger for 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' is the sentence about a separate construction site waste management plan. The source's refuse item asks small developments to show storage and disposal on plans and larger developments to provide a waste management strategy.
issues.evidence: Excerpt: 'A separate site waste management plan may be needed for the construction phase'

issues.detail: Several tab_items are contact details, process text or fragments. They include the 'Harrow Council, Planning and Building Control, PO Box 1358, Harrow, HA3 3QN' address mixed with drawing-scale text, the 21-day notice for invalid applications, the reference to 'Pre-Application Advice - Notes and Charges 2022/2023', 'This can be done electronically or 1 paper copy', and two sentences on publishing a redacted viability appraisal, which belong to the viability item.

Other application types show '(none)' or are incomplete, though the document's Section 3 lists specific items. Listed building consent (and householder plus LBC) needs plans of new doors, windows, shopfronts, panelling, fireplaces and plaster moulding. Minerals applications need existing and proposed level surveys. Telecoms prior notification needs evidence of notices to the aerodrome, CAA or MoD within 3 km of an aerodrome. The document also covers Prior Approval (Upwards Extension), which Grokbot did not record.
issues.evidence: Title: 'National and Local Validation Checklist of Planning Applications and Prior Approval (Upwards Extension) Requirements'

summary: Grokbot's link is Harrow's current list, dated 1 February 2024 in the text, not the 2024-01-01 metadata date. The extraction misses the Householder section entirely and around 18 local items, such as affordable housing, noise, transport, trees, protected views and RAF Northolt safeguarding. Many triggers are fragments or belong to the wrong item.
